name: stepthru
description: Step-through algorithm figures: trace your real code, get a playable SVG with captions.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module -e "const { traceArray, toHTML } = await import('stepthru'); const t = traceArray([2, 1]); t.at(1); t.watch({ i: 0 }); t.swap(0, 1); const html = toHTML(t, { code: 'swap()' }); if (!t.view(t.steps[1].state).startsWith('<svg') || !html.includes('stepthru-code')) throw new Error('smoke test failed'); console.log('smoke ok');"

author: Tuguldur Bayartsolmon
